comparator_definitions.sql_direct: S-D: thin external wrapper over matched PostgreSQL SQL, full-text search, pgvector and adjacency tables; one call per operation
comparator_definitions.sql_composed: S-C: the same SQL wrapper executing composed plans
comparator_definitions.extension_direct: E-D: pg-evidence, one call per operation
comparator_definitions.files_ripgrep: Files + ripgrep + exact file reads over identical allowed source data
comparator_definitions.pgvector_exact: pgvector exact scan; vector ground truth

external_comparator_rule: Install a pinned compatible release or record unmeasured with its reason; never substitute vendor-published numbers. Alternative stacks use native indexes and documented tuning; version/citation tasks route them through the same counted SQL provenance adapter.

files_ripgrep.note: Workflow comparison only; cannot alone attribute savings to extension execution

secondary_contrasts.note: All other contrasts, including E-D versus S-D, are descriptive

token_ratio.definition: Ratio of mean total model tokens per attempted question: average repetitions within each question, then weight each question equally
token_ratio.counted_tokens: All model input and output tokens, including cached usage, schemas, generated code, failed calls, retries, expansion, verification and any summarization or extra model use

supported_answer_rate_difference.definition: Supported-answer rate of the first arm minus the second, per the frozen answer-support rubric, averaged as for token_ratio

composition_claim.multiplicity: Only this joint rule supports a claim; no adjustment is needed because one claim is tested. Any added claim requires a predeclared adjustment before the final run.
composition_claim.release_gate: The live evaluation must be run, adjudicated and published whether or not the claim rule passes

claim_scope.below_minimum: Claims are limited to the evaluated corpora
claim_scope.uncertainty: Cluster uncertainty by source group according to the sampling design

question_splits.duplicate_detection: Detect duplicate and near-duplicate sources across groups before freezing splits
question_splits.pilot_note: The pilot size is a planning value; it does not justify the final holdout size

database_matrix.notes: Freeze a representative core matrix plus separate history, selectivity, skew and memory-pressure sweeps; do not run the full Cartesian product. Narrowing scale or concurrency requires a documented concrete resource limitation.

initial_database_schedule.note: Pilot schedule; may change only before the final freeze

cache_policy.headline: warm_steady_state
cache_policy.cold_start_procedure: Documented separately per run; a PostgreSQL restart alone does not clear the operating-system page cache, so state the actual cache-clearing procedure
cache_policy.comparator_order: Alternate comparator order and start from equivalent dataset snapshots

timeout_accounting.rule: Timeouts, failures, late and skipped requests are reported and remain in denominators
